title: TO BE LIKE JESUS

lines.text: To be like Jesus, to be like Jesus,
All I ask, to be like Him
All I ask, to be like Him.
To be like Jesus, to be like Jesus,
All I ask, to be like Him,
Not in a measure but in His fullness,
All I ask, to be like Him.

chords:
[Chorus]
[G]To be like Jesus, [C]to be like [G]Jesus,
[G]All I [A][D]ask, to be like [D][G]Him

[Verse 1]
[G]All thru life'[C]s journey,
[G]from earth to [D]glory,
All I ask, to be like Him.

[Chorus]
To be like Jesus, to be like Jesus,
All I ask, to be like Him,

[Verse 2]
[G]Not in a [C]measure but [G]in His [D]fullness,
All I ask, to be like Him.
